dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.macro_annuli_edge_geometry: The most prominent O and C shaped structures in the mid-dorsal region exhibit irregular, jagged outer perimeters with a sharp high-contrast transition from low-intensity background pixels to high-intensity ring perimeters.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.high_intensity_blob_density: A high concentration of amorphous, high-intensity pixel clusters lacking internal gradients is visible in the posterior-lateral quadrant and the anterior region near the ventral edge.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.constellation_keypoints: The centroids of the three largest mid-dorsal annuli form a defined obtuse triangle, while a sequence of four smaller annuli in the anterior-dorsal region forms a roughly linear geometric arrangement.
